Cohort: GLASS RNA silver-set (IDH-mutant, RT-annotated, TP+R1 paired)
Notes: Bulk RNA-seq deconvolved with stock published signatures; 45 / 9 paired samples at primary and recurrent. No matched single-nucleus data.

IDH-mutant recurrent samples with non-missing treatment; cross-sectional (no matched primary tumour), so no interaction can be estimated. Of 148 IDH-mutant recurrent samples, 129 had non-missing treatment.

Role in this study: Counts only; no patient-level or per-sample values are reported. Where a stratum contained fewer than five patients it would be reported as 'fewer than 5'; no reported stratum falls below this. The bulk RNA arm of the EGA Yale DAC was not used (raw reads exceeded local processing capacity and added little over the open single-nucleus arm).
